name: dmcheck
description: Deterministic conduct verdicts for live tabletop sessions. Input: a strict UTF-8 transcript (JSONL {ts,author,content,id?,audience?,correlation_id?} or Discord-API JSON array), an optional engine ledger, and a versioned table charter. Output: a typed EvaluationResult whose findings cite the violated charter rule, effective policy, provenance, and redacted evidence. Explicit source references correlate obligations; ambiguity produces silence while unusable evidence fails closed.

commands.dmcheck run <transcript> --gm <name> [--: referee the session; findings as JSON
commands.dmcheck rules: the active rule set plus the retired R5 compatibility id, with definitions

boundaries: Table conduct and communication only: never action legality. srdcheck is advisory; authorized upstream state plus the DM/table decide. No character math (charactercheck), narrative-quality judging (taste is not checkable), or model calls.
